posts.quote:
The trail doesn't ask
how fast you are.
Only that you keep
putting one foot down.

Some days the summit hides.
You climb anyway,
and the clouds
become the view.

Cold water, tired legs,
and nowhere else
I'd rather be.

The mountain was here
long before my worries,
and it will be here
long after them.

You don't need to see
the whole path.
Just the next
few steps.

The mountains are calling
and I must go.
posts.author: John Muir

posts.quote:
Quiet out here.
Just the wind,
my breath,
and the next step.
